document.abstract: As i write this update, I am on an airplane traveling home after our very successful June Standards meetings in Shanghai, China. Thanks to our hosts East China Television Technology League and Shanghai Media Group (SMG) for an excellent week in Shanghai. We are still looking for hosts for two of our Standards meetings in 2018. If you are interested, contact me or Howard Lukk, Director of Engineering and Standards.
